description.zh:
指定新创建主机的地址类型。取值：
- **Public**：公网地址
- **Private**：私网地址
description.en:
The address type of the host. Valid values:

- **Public**: a public address

- **Private**: a private address

description.zh: 指定主机的备注信息，最多支持500字符。
description.en: The comment for the host. The comment can be up to 500 characters in length.

description.zh: 指定新创建主机的名称，最多支持128字符。
description.en: The name of the host. The name can be up to 128 characters in length.

description.zh:
指定新创建主机的私网地址，可使用域名或IP地址。
> **ActiveAddressType**选择**Private**时，该参数为必填项。
description.en:
The private address of the host. You can use a domain name or an IP address.

> This parameter is required when **ActiveAddressType** is set to **Private**.

description.zh:
指定新创建主机的公网地址，可使用域名或IP地址。
> **ActiveAddressType**选择**Public**时，该参数为必填项。
description.en:
The public address of the host. You can use a domain name or an IP address.

> This parameter is required when **ActiveAddressType** is set to **Public**.

description.zh:
指定新创建主机所在堡垒机的实例ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeInstances](~~153281~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the Bastionhost instance where you want to create the host.

> Call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

description.zh: 指定新创建的ECS实例所属的主账号ID。
description.en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the ECS instance belongs.

description.zh:
指定新创建的ECS实例或专属集群主机所属区域ID。  
> **Source**选择**Ecs**或**Rds**时，该参数为必填项。
description.en:
The region ID of the ECS instance or the host in the dedicated cluster.

> This parameter is required when **Source** is set to **Ecs** or **Rds**.

description.zh:
指定新创建主机所属的网络域ID。
> 您可以调用[ListNetworkDomains ](~~2758827~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the network domain to which the host belongs.

> Call the [ListNetworkDomains ](~~2758827~~)operation to obtain this parameter.

description.zh:
指定新创建主机的操作系统。取值：
- **Linux**
- **Windows**
description.en:
The operating system of the host. Valid values:

- **Linux**

- **Windows**

description.zh:
指定新创建主机所在堡垒机的地域ID。
> Region ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见[地域和可用区](~~40654~~)。
description.en:
The region ID of the Bastionhost instance where you want to create the host.

> For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

description.zh:
指定新创建主机的来源。取值：
- **Local**：本地主机
- **Ecs**：ECS实例
- **Rds**：RDS专属集群主机
description.en:
The source of the host. Valid values:

- **Local**: a local host

- **Ecs**: an ECS instance

- **Rds**: a host in an ApsaraDB RDS dedicated cluster

description.zh:
指定新创建的ECS实例ID或专属集群主机ID。  
> **Source**选择**Ecs**或**Rds**时，该参数为必填项。
description.en:
The ID of the ECS instance or the host in the dedicated cluster.

> This parameter is required when **Source** is set to **Ecs** or **Rds**.

title.zh: 在堡垒机中创建需要运维的主机

example.unifiedCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost create-host --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --host-private-address 192.168.XX.XX --host-public-address 172.16.XX.XX --active-address-type Public --host-name host01 --source Local --os-type Linux --comment Local_Host --source-instance-id i-dfabfda --instance-region-id cn-hangzhou --network-domain-id 1 --instance-member-id 1605494 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost CreateHost --region cn-hangzhou --Comment Local_Host --InstanceId 'bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000' --InstanceMemberId 1605494 --SourceInstanceId 'i-dfabfda' --Source Local --ActiveAddressType Public --HostPrivateAddress '192.168.XX.XX' --InstanceRegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --HostPublicAddress '172.16.XX.XX' --OSType Linux --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --HostName host01 --NetworkDomainId 1
